CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_api_token(token TEXT) RETURNS TABLE(client_id UUID, scopes TEXT[], is_valid BOOLEAN) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public. Behavior: SELECTs t.client_id, t.scopes, and (t.expires_at > now() AND c.is_active) AS is_valid from public.api_access_tokens t JOIN public.api_clients c ON c.id = t.client_id WHERE t.access_token = token LIMIT 1; then UPDATEs public.api_access_tokens SET last_used_at = now() WHERE access_token = token. Tables touched: api_access_tokens (read+write), api_clients (read).

Backfills subsection_documents COC columns from existing coc_validations rows (joined via cv.document_id = sd.id, only where cv.report_data->>'cocNumber' IS NOT NULL): coc_number = cv.report_data->>'cocNumber'; coc_issue_date = (cv.report_data->>'cocIssueDate')::date; coc_type = 'supplementary' when LOWER(cv.report_data->>'cocType') ILIKE '%supplementary%' else 'initial'; coc_status = 'approved' when cv.status = 'Pass', 'rejected' when cv.status = 'Fail', else 'pending'. Matters because it populates denormalized COC metadata on documents using values conforming to the then-current CHECK constraints.

UPDATE subsections SET is_compliant = false WHERE id IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.id FROM subsections s JOIN coc_validations v ON v.subsection_id = s.id WHERE v.report_data->>'overallStatus' IN ('Fail','Failed','Invalid','FAIL') OR v.report_data->'hierarchyValidation'->>'hierarchyStatus' LIKE '%Invalid%' OR (v.report_data->'criticalFailures' IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(v.report_data->'criticalFailures') > 0)). Corrects subsections wrongly marked compliant despite failed validations.

UPDATE subsections SET is_compliant = false WHERE coc_status IN ('Failed','rejected','Rejected','failed','invalid','Invalid') AND (is_compliant = true OR is_compliant IS NULL). Ensures subsections with failed/rejected coc_status are marked non-compliant.

Behavior: first UPDATEs public.client_access_links SET last_accessed_at = now(), access_count = access_count + 1 WHERE access_token = token AND is_active = true AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()); then RETURNs the row (id, link_type, client_id, site_id, subsection_id, and is_valid computed as is_active AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())) FROM public.client_access_links WHERE access_token = token LIMIT 1.
